4.1.9.text: exec_in_pod is now classified as a destructive tool, so not allowed under ALLOW_ONLY_NON_DESTRUCTIVE_TOOLS. @rr-paras-patel

4.1.8.text: Start in degraded mode instead of crashing when kubeconfig has no current-context, so MCP initialize still succeeds and cluster tools return a clear configuration error ( #377 ).

4.1.6.text: Bug fixes for specific tool calls and helm calls.

4.1.5.text: Bug fixes for certain helm commands.

4.1.2.text: Updating ALLOWED_TOOLS to fail early if misspelled tool in list. Thanks to @cyb3ralbert !

4.0.8.text: Updating SSE dns rebinding protection and adding support for exec_in_pod error outputs. Thanks to @KaloyanNaumov for the exec_in_pod updates.

4.0.7.text: Add security.mcpAuthToken to the Helm chart and warn at install time when http/sse transport runs without authentication ( #348 ).

4.0.6.text: Harden the kubectl/helm dangerous-flag guard against the attached short-flag token form ( #347 ).

4.0.5.text: Restrict server-side path reads (filename/valuesFile) to the stdio transport in kubectl_apply, kubectl_delete, and Helm chart tools ( #346 )

4.0.4.text: Readme cleanup: badges down to one line, replace Gemini CLI install directions with Codex ( #340 )

4.0.3.text: Fix kubectl_get output: "custom" failing under shell-less execFileSync by unquoting the custom-columns argument ( #339 )

4.0.2.text: Security hardening for remote (SSE / Streamable HTTP) deployments: restrict the kubectl_create filename and fromFile parameters — which resolve paths on the machine running the server — to the stdio transport, and add a fromFileContent parameter to populate ConfigMaps/Secrets from client-supplied content on any transport ( #332 ).

4.0.1.text: Security fix: mask Kubernetes Secret values regardless of the resourceType syntax used to request them (e.g. secret/<name> ), closing a masking bypass in kubectl_get (GHSA-w23h-64x4-22h9).

4.0.0.text: Security fix: guard the port_forward tool's argv against kubectl flag injection, closing the last unguarded exec path from the argument-injection report ( #328 ).

3.9.3.text: Updating kubectl generic to take allNamespaces flag and release cleanup.

3.9.2.text: Dependency version bump to remove protobuf 8.0.0 dependency.

3.9.1.text: Updating version number returned from mcp server to match actual version number of release. Thanks to @apoorvdarshan

3.9.0.text: Bug fixes and adding helm chart observability schema options. Thanks to @anthoai97 for the helm schema updates!

3.8.0.text: Enabling DNS rebinding protection by default. See docs for how to disable if necessary for testing.

3.7.0.text: kubectl_generic denylist for specific combinations of flags.

3.6.0.text: Bug fixes around env vars restricting tool calls.

3.5.1.text: Bug fixes: Fixing port_forward to return correct mcp spec. Thanks to @voron for the fix!

3.4.0.text: New kubectl_reconnect command and bug fixes: Add kubectl_reconnect to fix stale reconnects. Thanks to @BrunoChauvet ! Using constant time comparison for auth tokens. Thanks to @spidershield-contrib !

3.3.0.text: New features and bug fixes: Adding OpenTelemetry distributed tracing support #264 Refactoring exec_in_pod to use kubectl #271 Adding writable AWS credentials volume #266 Thanks to @rr-paras-patel and Claude.

3.2.2.text: Adding .zip to release in addition to .mcpb to support gemini CLI. Thansk to @tymorton !

3.2.1.text: Updating status to be more accurate to kubectl response.

3.2.0.text: Adding support for custom volumes in helm chart. Thanks to @smunukutla-mycarrier ! Adding X-MCP-AUTH as a simple authentication mechanism for server running in sse / streamable-http servers.

3.1.1.text: Fixing required name for kubectl_get and kubectl_delete (not actually required).

3.0.4.text: Update for TLS_VERIFY and CA_CERT. Thanks to @Konstantinov-Innokentii !

3.0.3.text: Multiple bug fixes & improvements: Updates to helm charts - supporting custom init containers & removing an unsupported gcloud parameter. Thanks to @milvito ! Prioritize env vars (K8S_SERVER / K8S_TOKEN) over incluster credentials (providing env vars takes precedence if they are provided). Thanks to @ashlkv ! Allowing passing a CA certificate data via env var K8S_CA_DATA to allow for TLS verification. Thanks to @Konstantinov-Innokentii !

3.0.2.text: Adding MCPError if kubectl patch receives a string instead of object.

3.0.1.text: Helm chart publishing needed additional permissions for updated cd.yml publishing with npm trusted publishers.

2.9.9.text: cd.yml fix for helm chart publishing error.

2.9.7.text: Fix up bug in closing streamable-http servers. Thanks to @reckless-huang !

2.9.5.text: Updating .dxtignore to be .mcpbignore to reduce size of mcpb bundle.

2.9.3.text: Adding readOnlyHint and destructiveHint to tool schemas.

2.9.2.text: Updating manifest.json to include readOnlyHint and destructiveHint.

2.9.1.text: Bugfix for parsing context names with special characters like @ and : . Thanks to @reckless-huang for this fix!

2.9.0.text: Adding health & readiness endpoints /health and /ready for SSE & Streamable HTTP. Thanks to @rr-krupesh-savaliya ! Adding support for installing Helm charts using YAML manifests & updating node management. Thanks to @Himanshukrojha !

2.8.0.text: Allowing context to be passed for all tools. Thanks to @jvitor03 !

2.6.0.text: Secrets masking is enabled by default for kubectl get secrets commands. Thanks to @cybercuisine ! For more information, read the ADVANCED_README . To disable use env var MASK_SECRETS=false .

2.5.1.text: Updating manifest.json for dxt format. Thanks @felixrieseberg !

2.5.0.text: New Features: Adding SPAWN_MAX_BUFFER env var for buffers larger than 1MB (see #172 ). Adding ALLOW_ONLY_READONLY_TOOLS env var which is a more restrictive subset of tools than non-destructive. Also adding ALLOWED_TOOLS for users to customize an include list for tools (only allowing those tools in the include list). See #173 . Bug fixes: Removing optional keyword from exec_in_pod schema. See #177 . Thanks @anthonysr ! Misc: Changing all execSync to execFileSync . See #174 . Adding Citation.cff. Thanks @rr-paras-patel ! See #178 .

2.4.9.text: DXT manifest.json updates for sane defaults.

2.4.8.text: Fixing up user config so that dxt extension doesn't fail without user argument.

2.4.7.text: Removing minikube binary from dxt package.

2.4.6.text: Creating new dxt with long_description from #166

2.4.1.text: Adding support for HOST variable when starting SSE transport.

2.4.0.text: Updating docker container and required parameters for tool calls. Thanks to @kkambhat

2.3.0.text: Bug Fixes for kubeconfig env loading

2.2.0.text: Adding ability to pass kubeconfig in different ways (as string in yaml, json, custom kubeconfig_path, etc.). Thanks to @spo0nman !

2.1.1.text: Fixing console logs that show errors in Claude Desktop. Thanks to @aliou

2.1.0.text: Kubernetes MCP Server can now run inside a cluster (make sure container you run in also has kubectl installed). Thanks to @ajit-pendse for this feature!

2.0.0.text: Complete refactor to use kubectl for most commands. Huge thanks to @rr-paras-patel !

1.6.2.text: Fixing jsonpath-plus cve in previous version of kubenetes/client-node. Thanks to @tx-chen

1.6.1.text: Changing list_pods result to return "phase" instead of "status" as described by this: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/#pod-phase

1.6.0.text: Adding config map get, update, delete support. Thanks to @rr-paras-patel !

1.5.0.text: Adding describe service, update service, and delete service tools. Thanks to @barrycheng05 ! Adding describe node tool. Thanks to @osw282 !

1.4.0.text: Adding create_service, update_deployment tools. Adding context management tools: list_context, set_context, get_context. Adding a ALLOW_ONLY_NON_DESTRUCTIVE_TOOLS flag that allows users to disable delete tools for the MCP server.

1.3.1.text: Fixing properties in helm charts & namespace return result
